fictional_company.one_sentence_positioning: RouteSignal CRM helps inbound sales teams capture, route, follow up, and review ownership of demo and contact-sales requests.

target_account_context.buyer_role: the person handling inbound demo follow-up

ideal_customer_profile.best_for: B2B teams with 3 to 250 sales or customer-operations users that receive inbound demo or contact-sales requests.
ideal_customer_profile.weak_fit: Teams with almost no inbound demand, regulated emergency support, payment processing, legal advice, or medical advice workflows.
common_pains: new requests wait in a shared inbox or spreadsheet
handoff status is hard for managers to verify
teams cannot tell whether routing delays are costing time

product_knowledge.short_product_explanation: RouteSignal CRM routes leads, captures follow-up tasks, and shows handoff status so inbound requests do not sit in a spreadsheet.
workflow_scope: routing by region, source, priority, or owner

plans.name: Starter
plans.best_for: small teams moving from spreadsheets to a shared lead workflow

plans.name: Growth
plans.best_for: teams that need routing automation and manager visibility

safe_selling_points: keeps lead ownership visible after the first handoff
reduces manual routing and reminder work when inbound volume is real
helps managers see whether follow-up happened
lets small teams start with basic routing before paying for heavier automation

integration_boundary.safe_summary: The fictional profile supports common CRM ownership-field workflows, including Salesforce-style and HubSpot-style routing concepts.
integration_boundary.exact_setup_boundary: Exact Salesforce, HubSpot, permissions, object mapping, and security details must be verified before making a compatibility claim.

security_boundary.safe_summary: Security questions should use verified security material before a serious rollout discussion.

qualification_talk_tracks: inbound demo requests need a clear owner, a callback task, and manager visibility
RouteSignal helps when leads sit in spreadsheets or shared inboxes after the first form fill
the useful check is where momentum is lost: routing, reminders, handoff review, or visibility
Growth is only worth discussing when missed callbacks, messy handoffs, or routing delay happen often
a short workflow review should inspect one gap first, not turn into a long software demo

source_inspiration.name: Chili Piper lead routing software public page
source_inspiration.observed_pattern: lead routing products position around qualifying inbound demand, matching buyers to the right owner, scheduling next steps, and tracking routing performance.

source_inspiration.name: Calendly routing public page
source_inspiration.observed_pattern: routing workflows commonly combine form answers, CRM ownership lookup, scheduling, booking confirmation, and performance analytics.

source_inspiration.name: HubSpot lead scoring public page
source_inspiration.observed_pattern: sales tools often prioritize leads using fit and engagement signals before follow-up work is assigned.

source_inspiration.name: LeanData speed-to-lead public page
source_inspiration.observed_pattern: lead-management systems emphasize reducing routing delay, avoiding duplicate records, acting on buyer signals, and using automation without claiming guaranteed outcomes.
